title: Misty Eastern Canal Village
description: A narrow canal winds through an ancient East Asian-inspired town at dusk. Multi-story wooden buildings with glowing lantern-lit windows line the stone-paved waterfront, connected by arched walkways and wooden docks, while a lone figure in a cloak stands on the right pier gazing toward a towering pagoda in the foggy distance.
prompt: A misty East Asian canal town at dusk, tall multi-story wooden buildings with glowing arched windows and hanging lanterns line both sides of the narrow waterway, stone walkways and wooden docks, a lone cloaked figure standing on a pier, towering multi-tiered pagoda visible through thick fog in the background, atmospheric lighting, intricate architectural details, moody and serene fantasy scene
